source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; compare the BMC SEL WebUI with `ipmitool sel elist`; use `Save Logs`; then use `Clear All Logs`.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information/messages match status; BMC SEL exports and clears successfully.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES runs `sel list` and only the final 50 `sel elist` lines with fixed cipher and visible password, yet calls the result FULL and no-risk; it omits WebUI, Save Logs and clear.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION restores full record comparison, export and a separately approved clear, rejecting initial clear and truncated output.

old_problem: The source destroys the SEL before comparison/export, then clears again; the proposed command truncates the supposedly complete evidence and does not implement WebUI, export or clear. Cross-rendering equality, Script provenance, credential/cipher support, full-export semantics and destructive scope were unresolved.
disposition_reason: The safe review method is determinable: preserve the existing SEL, bind the supported IPMI transport and a pinned reviewed Script (or approved manual equivalent), capture `sel info` plus every record, correlate canonical event identity across ipmitool/WebUI/export rather than literal strings, verify and retain the complete Save Logs artifact, then obtain fresh approval for one scoped clear. OEM values remain execution prerequisites and do not require a new engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 861, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
`sel list`, `sel elist`, raw records, SDR-based rendering, WebUI and exported files may describe the same event differently; record identity and normalized fields are the correct comparison basis.
ED-17 requires backup before BMC/SEL deletion; ED-20 preserves WebUI, ipmitool, Save Logs and Clear All coverage; ED-35 rejects a truncated CLI sample as substitution.
ED-38 requires pinned reviewed automation, protected credentials, exact target, one-time approval, recovery and no automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: Correlate complete BMC SEL across WebUI and ipmitool, validate Save Logs, then perform one approved scoped clear
test_case.purpose: Prove every bounded BMC SEL record is represented consistently in the WebUI and the supported full `ipmitool sel elist`/raw view using canonical identity fields; prove `Save Logs` contains that complete set; then, after verified retention and fresh explicit authorization, invoke one SEL clear and prove the defined post-state without affecting other log services.
required_package: Exact lab BMC/certificate, firmware/WebUI build, SEL service, account role, maintenance window and supported IPMI transport/cipher/privilege
Pinned immutable commit/tag and readable content/checksum/dependency review for the referenced `bmc-logs/sel-logs` Script, or signed approved manual method
Validated ipmitool version and protected credential/session mechanism; exact commands for `sel info`, full `sel elist` and raw evidence without output truncation
Canonical mapping for SEL record ID, sensor number/type/name, raw event data, generator, assert/deassert direction, timestamp/timezone, message/status and vendor SDR repository/decoder
Save Logs filename, MIME/container, encoding/schema, pagination/full-scope behavior, parser, checksum, retention/redaction and concurrent-event boundary method
Exact one-time SEL clear semantics, clear marker/count/sequence boundary, excluded-service observers, explicit authority, alternate OOB access and incident escalation
test_case.test_command: Do not pre-clear. Confirm the exact target and supported protected IPMI session. Record `sel info`, count/capacity/overflow/sequence and capture all `sel elist` plus raw fields without `head`, `tail`, filters or terminal truncation, with stdout/stderr/exit status separated. Bound concurrent events, snapshot the WebUI and join entries by record ID/raw event identity; compare sensor, direction, event data, time and status using the approved SDR/timezone mapping rather than literal rendered text. Invoke WebUI `Save Logs` once, quarantine/hash/parse it and reconcile every bounded record. Present the exact target/service, retained checksum/location, excluded services and post-state, then obtain fresh explicit approval. Invoke the supported SEL clear exactly once and verify the defined count/marker/new sequence plus preservation of excluded Audit/security/system logs. Do not execute the internal Script until its immutable revision is accessible and safety-reviewed; never use `-P`, assume cipher 17, or retry clear.
test_case.expected_result: The complete bounded SEL has no unexplained missing, duplicate or mismatched record across canonical ipmitool/raw, WebUI and parsed Save Logs representations; approved decoder/timezone presentation differences are documented. The export is complete, valid and retained. Following fresh approval, one clear reaches the vendor-defined SEL post-state and expected marker/boundary while unrelated log services and retained evidence remain intact. No initial clear, truncation, credential disclosure, unsupported Script or repeated destructive action occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target/tool/Script provenance, full non-truncated SEL metadata and records, canonical record-by-record WebUI and export reconciliation, verified retained export, immediate approval, exactly one scoped clear, correct post-state and excluded-service proof, with engineer verdict. Recent-only output, literal string equality, a UI toast, file existence or empty display alone cannot pass. Unexplained field/record mismatch, incomplete export, overflow without bounded reconciliation, wrong/multiple clear or cross-service loss is FAIL. Missing Script/tool/mapping/export/clear inputs or approval is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Never perform the generic pre-test clear; it destroys the SEL oracle required for WebUI/ipmitool/export comparison.
Never call `tail -50`, filtered output or a terminal sample complete; preserve `sel info`, every record, raw identity, exit status and stderr.
Do not compare rendered strings literally; use canonical record and raw event identity with approved SDR, locale and timezone transformations.
Do not run the internal Script until an immutable readable revision is reviewed for targets, secrets, clear timing, retries, errors and dependencies.
Do not expose secrets with `-P`, assume cipher suite 17 or weaken TLS; use the platform-approved protected authentication method.
Clear only after complete verified export and fresh explicit approval, invoke once, observe excluded services and never retry automatically.
expected_evidence: BMC/SEL identity, certificate, firmware/WebUI build, role, ipmitool version, protected transport/cipher/privilege and SDR repository identity
Pinned internal Script commit/checksum/content safety review or signed alternate-method approval
Complete pre-clear `sel info`, capacity/overflow/sequence and all entry/raw evidence with separate stdout/stderr/exit status
Record-keyed WebUI correlation across sensor, raw event, direction, timestamp/timezone, message/status and documented decoder differences
Save Logs trusted-origin metadata, size, checksum, parser result and complete bounded record reconciliation
Fresh clear approval, one exact action/response, post-state marker/count/sequence, excluded-service proof, no retry and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The complete checksummed retained SEL export is the pre-clear evidence recovery control; erased controller records may not be restorable. On target mismatch, unexpected deletion, mapping failure or unknown response, stop, preserve action/audit evidence and invoke only the approved vendor/OOB incident procedure. Do not rerun the Script or clear, and never fabricate missing SEL entries.
